title: Lab 3A — ElastiCache (Redis) cache-aside in front of Aurora
topic: Redis vs Memcached, cache-aside pattern, ElastiCache in VPC security groups, Lambda-in-VPC tradeoff, CloudFront vs ElastiCache vs DAX, TTL invalidation
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-23-elasticache-redis.md and night-23-lab-elasticache-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-23-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: GSA dashboard hammers SELECT resort_stats for IS-001 thousands of times per minute. Aurora CPU spikes. You add ElastiCache in the same VPC. Which pattern does night-23-lab implement?

options.A: Cache-aside — app reads Redis first; on miss queries Aurora then SETEX with TTL
options.B: Write-through — every Aurora UPSERT also writes Redis before commit
options.C: Read-through — ElastiCache service pulls Aurora rows without app code
options.D: Write-behind — Redis batches async flushes to Aurora every hour

questions.question: An exam scenario needs session storage with sorted-set leaderboards and optional Multi-AZ automatic failover. Memcached or Redis?

options.A: Memcached — multithreaded horizontal scale with no data types
options.B: S3 Standard — session objects with 11 nines durability
options.C: DynamoDB DAX — in-memory accelerator for DynamoDB only
options.D: ElastiCache Redis — richer types, replication groups, failover options

questions.question: night-23-lab places saa-study-gsa-redis in Night 9 private subnets. Which ingress rule belongs on saa-study-gsa-redis-sg?

options.A: TCP 5432 from lambda-stats-sg — Redis uses the PostgreSQL port
options.B: TCP 6379 from saa-study-gsa-lambda-stats-sg — source is the app security group
options.C: TCP 443 from the internet gateway for TLS termination at Redis
options.D: TCP 6379 from 0.0.0.0/0 so operators can redis-cli from home

questions.question: saa-study-gsa-cache-reader runs in private subnets like Night 17 stats-uploader. First invoke after idle takes 30+ seconds. Primary cause?

options.A: ElastiCache Redis scales to zero and must cold-boot from S3
options.B: Lambda VPC ENI attach on cold start before private Redis/Aurora paths work
options.C: Aurora Serverless v2 pauses the writer until cache-reader pings it
options.D: Secrets Manager throttles GetSecretValue to one call per minute

questions.question: Static wiki HTML is cached at CloudFront POPs. Relational resort_stats rows are cached in Redis inside the VPC. What is the best distinction?

options.A: CloudFront replaces Aurora; ElastiCache replaces DynamoDB
options.B: Both are identical layers — pick whichever is cheaper that month
options.C: CloudFront caches HTTP responses at the edge; ElastiCache caches app-chosen objects near compute
options.D: CloudFront requires VPC endpoints; ElastiCache requires an internet gateway

questions.question: Wiki viewCount hot reads already live on DynamoDB (Night 18). Which AWS cache targets DynamoDB specifically?

options.A: DAX — DynamoDB Accelerator for microsecond DynamoDB reads
options.B: CloudFront origin shield in the database subnet
options.C: ElastiCache Memcached cluster in front of the wiki table
options.D: Aurora read replica in front of the WikiPages table

questions.question: Night 17 stats-uploader UPSERTs monthly_runs in Aurora. Night 23 cache-reader may return stale counts until TTL expires. Exam-aligned mitigation?

options.A: Disable Aurora automated backups so writes propagate faster
options.B: Delete or update the Redis key on successful write (cache invalidation)
options.C: Move Redis to a public subnet for lower latency invalidation
options.D: Switch to Memcached because it never caches relational rows

questions.question: You need the simplest horizontal in-memory cache for opaque JSON blobs — no failover, no lists or sets. Best fit?

options.A: ElastiCache Redis with cluster mode and AOF persistence enabled
options.B: Aurora Global Database for sub-millisecond wiki reads
options.C: DMS CDC task streaming cache entries into Redis
options.D: ElastiCache Memcached — multithreaded key-value without advanced structures

questions.question: An operator asks whether saa-study-gsa-redis is the system of record for resort_stats. Correct answer?

options.A: Yes — ElastiCache persists all writes to EBS like RDS
options.B: Yes — Redis snapshots replace Aurora automated backups
options.C: No — Aurora remains source of truth; Redis is ephemeral acceleration
options.D: No — only DynamoDB can be a source of truth in AWS

questions.question: night-23-lab creates saa-study-gsa-redis-subnets spanning private-a and private-b. Why is a cache subnet group required?

options.A: ElastiCache nodes must launch in subnets you designate — typically private DB/cache tiers
options.B: Subnet groups encrypt Redis traffic with KMS at the subnet boundary
options.C: Subnet groups replace security groups for port 6379 authorization
options.D: Redis clusters cannot use security groups — subnet group is the only firewall

questions.question: Bench invoke clears the key then calls GET twice. Second response shows cache_hit true and lower latency_ms. What happened?

options.A: Aurora read replica served the second call from another Region
options.B: CloudFront edge cached the Lambda response between invokes
options.C: First call populated Redis via cache-aside; second call read RAM only
options.D: DAX intercepted the second call before DynamoDB

questions.question: Production Redis often enables in-transit encryption and AUTH tokens. night-23 study lab skips them. Why still deploy redis-sg?

options.A: Security groups are optional decoration when Redis is in a private subnet
options.B: Network ACLs alone block all east-west traffic in the VPC
options.C: IAM policies on the Lambda role replace SG rules for port 6379
options.D: SGs enforce which ENIs may open TCP 6379 — defense in depth inside the VPC

questions.question: High availability Redis with automatic failover to a replica in another AZ. Which ElastiCache construct?

options.A: Single-node cache.t4g.micro cluster with no replica — tonight's lab
options.B: Redis replication group with Multi-AZ and automatic failover enabled
options.C: Memcached cluster with one node per AZ and client-side hashing only
options.D: Aurora Serverless v2 reader endpoint in front of Redis

questions.question: saa-study-gsa-cache-reader reuses saa-study-gsa-lambda-stats-sg from Night 16/17. Which connections does that SG need to initiate?

options.A: Inbound TCP 6379 from redis-sg and inbound 5432 from aurora-sg
options.B: Inbound TCP 443 from API Gateway for cache warming webhooks
options.C: Outbound TCP 6379 to redis-sg and outbound TCP 5432 to aurora-sg
options.D: Outbound ICMP to the NAT gateway for Redis health probes

questions.question: You run night-23-lab-elasticache-teardown.ps1. Correct resource order concept?

options.A: Delete Lambda then ElastiCache cluster then subnet group and redis-sg — keep VPC and Aurora
options.B: Delete Night 9 VPC first so Redis loses its subnets automatically
options.C: Delete Aurora cluster before ElastiCache to flush cache keys
options.D: Delete redis-sg while the cluster is running to force immediate eviction
